periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique orientation, approximately 75 degrees relative to the horizontal facial axis, diverging laterally at the inferior poles.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated vertical oval with an estimated aspect ratio of 1.6:1 height-to-width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Distinct downward elongation present, with the lower half of the patch appearing more tapered than the rounded superior half.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Deep U-shape profile with a pronounced posterior extension along the spinal midline.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: The band is widest at the lateral shoulder junctions and narrows to approximately 70% of that thickness at the dorsal vertex.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: The medial gap between the ears is approximately equal to 1.8 times the individual width of one pinna.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Irregular curvature with a flattened, sub-acute apex rather than a continuous semi-circle.

other_distinctive_markers: Extreme lateral expansion of the fur in the genal/cheek region, creating an unusually wide, circular cranial silhouette.
